english.note: Use this colloquial noun when laziness is presented as someone's habitual or inherent tendency.
This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a habitual tendency to be lazy.

examples.english: My laziness has been there since I was little—I don't want to move whenever I'm on holiday.
examples.traditional: 我自細就有懶性，一放假就唔想郁。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zi6 sai3 zau6 jau5 laan5 sing3 jat1 fong3 gaa3 zau6 m4 soeng2 juk1

examples.english: His indolence is impossible to change; whatever we ask him to do, he puts it off until the last minute.
examples.traditional: 佢嘅懶性真係改唔到，叫佢做乜都拖到最後一刻。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 laan5 sing3 zan1 hai6 goi2 m4 dou3 giu3 keoi5 zou6 mat1 dou1 to1 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 hak1
